name: Data Sentinel
summary: Runtime/log diagnostics specialist for Spark and data platforms: event-log and failure diagnosis, Glue/EMR run inspection, SQL and plan analysis, doctor-bundle import. Diagnoses from runtime evidence; it is not an engineering producer.
appropriate_for: runtime failure diagnosis of Spark/Glue/EMR jobs from event logs, plans and run dumps
importing forge-doctor-data handoff bundles for independent diagnosis
inappropriate_for: producing Spark code or pipelines — it is a diagnostician, not a producer
static source review of a repository — route to spark-forge-* or forge-doctor-data
any run without the logs/plans/data its diagnostics require

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <sentinel-venv> && <sentinel-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <sentinel-python> -m pip install "data-sentinel-forge>=0.1.0,<0.2.0"

limitations_note: UNADAPTED (lf-0031 documented gap): data-sentinel-forge ships forge.agentic.json + forge.json and a governed CLI, but has no the-forge adapter — no Forge Protocol describe/health/execute surface, so it can never become VERIFIED today and every orchestration pick resolves to a provider-absent/degraded refusal, never a silent skip. Its diagnostics also require runtime evidence (event logs, plans, run dumps): the orchestration lane refuses to force a sentinel diagnosis when the caller declares no such inputs. A full sentinel adapter is the scope of a later spec.
examples: diagnose the glue job failure from its run logs
